string.text: VG-40OP

VG-40OP is an illumination grenade with parachute. A slowly descending flare will review a wide area on the battlefield.

M18 smoke grenade

A US Army smoke grenade used as a ground-to-ground or ground-to-air signaling device, a target or landing zone marking device, or a screening device for unit maneuvering.

RDG-2 smoke grenade

The RDG-2 is a cheap, simple, Soviet-era smoke grenade found in many Eastern European countries. The casing is made from cylindrical cardboard with two coloured caps on the end where the smoke is deployed from. The RDG-2 is used as a means to signal friendly forces or as a screening device.

An improvised explosive trap kit made of tent pegs, wooden stakes, wire, and a hand grenade. Any human or mutant passing through the wire will trigger the attached grenade.

Improvised explosive trigger

An improvised explosive trigger made from scavenged communication devices and electrical components. It can be used as a component for improvised explosive recipes.

Improvised explosive device (based on PG-7V warhead)
IED (PG-7V warhead)

An improvised explosive device built from a PG-7V warhead and a modified cellphone trigger. The impact fuse was removed and replaced with a cellphone for remote detonation. This modification renders the warhead incompatible with rocket launcher, which greatly reduce its value. Traders no longer accept them for trading.

IED (explosive charge)

An improvised explosive device built from an explosive charge and a modified cellphone trigger. The time fuse was removed and replaced with a cellphone for remote detonation. The explosive charge lost its original intended purposes, which greatly reduce its value. Traders no longer accept them for trading.

FPV freestyle drone

A FPV freestyle drone assembled from parts supplied by different brands for either cheapest or most available. Solid construction allows the attachment of an additional payload, mostly remote-controlled explosive devices. Though a cheap camera provides a limited reconnaissance capability.

DJI Phantom 2

Consumer-grade reconnaissance drone. DJI Phantom 2 provides short-range aerial surveillance and target spotting. Lightweight construction gives no room for additional payload but allows rapid deployment and recovery. Suitable for scouting, observation, and mapping missions.
